_: Class options whose EMBEDDED description (public/core.json classes.<id>.subclass.options[] / extraChoices[].options[]) may differ from their classFeatures record's (public/core-descriptions.json), each with why: either the RECORD is the damaged or shorter text, or the option text is deliberately a part of the record's (a ruling pinned by a test). The chain's sync (scripts/lib/embedded-descriptions.mjs) leaves these copies as their writers made them. scripts/embedded-description-check.mjs accepts a line here only while the pair still differs: when the two agree the line must go (it only shrinks). Measured 2026-09-30 over the 46 options whose copy differed at a787fb0: 31 now carry their record's text, 15 kept theirs; 2 of those 15 were damaged RECORDS (inventor/light-mortar-innovation, the @-link cleaner's 'form a instead of a .'; necromancer/puppeteer, the Consume Thrall block missing), and both records were repaired from their Archives pages (innovation-4, fatal-method-1) by overlay description rows the same day, so their lines left. Only ruling-pinned shorter options remain below (13).
